novel_features.name: Namespace stats summary
novel_features.description: Per-namespace record counts and size across all your indexes, in one query.
novel_features.rationale: Combines describe_index_stats responses across all indexes locally — no native cross-index view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this monthly to find namespaces that have grown out of expected bounds before they hit quota.

novel_features.name: Index inventory
novel_features.description: All indexes with their dimension, metric, host, status, and last-modified time.
novel_features.rationale: Wraps list_indexes + describe_index in one call with consistent --json output.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in CI to verify expected indexes exist before running vector operations.

novel_features.name: Reachability check
novel_features.description: Verifies API key works AND each index's data-plane host is reachable.
novel_features.rationale: Standard doctor only checks control-plane. Pinecone data-plane uses per-index hosts that can be unreachable even when control-plane works.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in CI/cron to catch host-routing issues before they break data-plane operations.

novel_features.name: Bulk delete by filter
novel_features.description: Delete vectors matching a metadata filter across one or many namespaces with --dry-run preview.
novel_features.rationale: Wraps /vectors/delete with safer --dry-run that lists what would be deleted before the actual delete.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for cleanup with a confirmation step — destructive operations should never be one-step.

novel_features.name: Cascading-search local cache
novel_features.description: Cascading search across multiple namespaces with local result merging and rerank.
novel_features.rationale: Pinecone's cascading-search MCP tool does this server-side; this CLI version supports custom rerank weights and offline result caching.
novel_features.example: pinecone-pp-cli csearch --index client-impact --namespaces features,tasks --query 'time tracking sync' --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when you need cross-namespace results without paying for re-querying every time.

novel_features.name: Embedding-cost estimator
novel_features.description: Estimates inference cost for a batch of texts before submitting (input-token count × model price).
novel_features.rationale: Local tokenizer estimate + Pinecone's published model prices; no API call until you confirm.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before bulk embedding jobs to avoid surprise bills.

novel_features.name: Index drift
novel_features.description: Compares the last cached describe_index_stats vs current — surfaces namespaces that grew/shrank significantly.
novel_features.rationale: Compares local snapshot to live API — Pinecone has no native delta endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for daily health checks to catch unexpected ingestion stalls or growth spikes.

novel_features.name: Cross-index search
novel_features.description: Run the same query against multiple indexes in parallel, merge and rerank.
novel_features.rationale: Pinecone's API is per-index; cross-index search requires fanning out manually.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an entity could live in any of several indexes — single command, parallel queries.

narrative.headline: Every Pinecone API endpoint, plus cross-index search, namespace drift detection, and offline cost estimation.
narrative.value_prop: Full coverage of Pinecone's control plane (indexes, collections, backups), data plane (query, upsert, fetch, delete), and inference (embed, rerank) — plus cross-index search, namespace drift detection, bulk-delete with dry-run, and an offline cost estimator. Built on a synced local cache so cron-driven monitors and AI agents can answer 'has this namespace grown today?' without re-running describe-stats every minute.
narrative.auth_narrative: Pinecone uses API-key auth. Set PINECONE_API_KEY in your environment or run `pinecone-pp-cli auth set-token`. The control plane uses https://api.pinecone.io; data-plane endpoints (query, upsert) use per-index hosts returned by `describe_index` — the CLI resolves these automatically.

quickstart.comment: Single-index search via the cross-index command.

troubleshoots.fix: Check PINECONE_API_KEY is set (`pinecone-pp-cli auth status`). Get a key from app.pinecone.io.
Data-plane endpoints need the per-index host. Run `pinecone-pp-cli inventory` to see hosts; the CLI auto-resolves but you can override with `--host`.
Drift needs at least one prior `ns-stats` snapshot to compare against. Run `ns-stats` daily to seed the local cache.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for pinecone-pp-cli when you need to operate Pinecone programmatically — namespace audits, cross-index search, drift detection, embedding-cost estimation, or bulk cleanup with dry-run safety. For one-off CRUD on a single index, the official Python/TS SDKs are fine; use this CLI when local cache, multi-index ops, or cron-driven monitoring matter.

recipes.title: Morning namespace health check
recipes.explanation: Snapshots every namespace size across all indexes — pipe into your dashboard.

recipes.title: Drift alert (cron)
recipes.explanation: Exits non-zero when any namespace changed by more than 100 records vs the last snapshot. Pair with `ns-stats` daily.

recipes.title: Safe purge (always dry-run first)
recipes.explanation: Always run `--dry-run` to preview the affected count before committing. Filter is a JSON metadata expression matching Pinecone's filter language.

recipes.title: Cross-index search
recipes.explanation: Parallel query across indexes, merged + reranked locally.

recipes.title: Cost estimate before batch embed
recipes.explanation: Local tokenizer × published prices = estimated cost. No API hit.
